    "import numpy as np\n",
    "\n",
    "slopes = []\n",
    "\n",
    "for industry, group in df.groupby('industry'):\n",
    "    if len(group) > 10:  # avoid tiny samples\n",
    "        x = group['ai_adoption_score']\n",
    "        y = group['layoff_risk']\n",
    "        \n",
    "        slope = np.polyfit(x, y, 1)[0]\n",
    "        slopes.append((industry, slope))\n",
    "\n",
    "slopes_df = pd.DataFrame(slopes, columns=['industry', 'slope'])\n",
    "slopes_df.sort_values('slope', ascending=False)"
   ]
  },
